title_en: JANUS Biological Connectome–AI Hybrid: Brain Digitization and Neural–Transformer Coupling
title_ru: JANUS: гибрид цифрового коннектома и ИИ — оцифровка мозга и связь с трансформером

provenance.origin: User-proposed research concept in ChatGPT discussion on 2026-11-08
provenance.author_intent_ru: Исследовать возможность оцифровки реального мозга и соединения его цифровой модели с ИИ, включая потенциальное применение к JANUS.
provenance.historical_scope: Idea registration; not a scientific priority claim, implementation receipt, or evidence of commercial brain upload.

epistemic_status.scientific_claim_boundary: Connectome reconstruction, BCI signal decoding, virtual-body models and human mind uploading are distinct achievements; none implies the others.

validated_external_background.observation: Connectome of an adult female Drosophila brain, 139,255 neurons and 54.5 million synapses.
validated_external_background.interpretation_limit: An anatomical connectivity map is not a measured full dynamical or conscious brain.

validated_external_background.project: Google Research / Harvard human temporal cortex reconstruction
validated_external_background.observation: Approximately 1 mm^3 human cortex reconstructed: ~57,000 cells, ~150 million synapses, ~1.4 PB of data.
validated_external_background.interpretation_limit: A small anatomical tissue sample is not a complete human brain or a live functioning emulation.

validated_external_background.project: Eon Systems embodied virtual fruit fly
validated_external_background.observation: Connectome-constrained simplified neural model coupled to a MuJoCo virtual body with a sensorimotor feedback loop.
validated_external_background.interpretation_limit: Uses simplified neurons, hand-selected mappings and existing locomotor controllers; team reports incomplete biological validation. Company claims are not independent proof of faithful uploading.

conceptual_distinctions.connectome_digitization: Mapping synaptic wiring and cell identities, without necessarily capturing internal physiological states.
conceptual_distinctions.brain_computer_interface: Decoding limited live neural signals and/or delivering stimulation between brain and computer.
conceptual_distinctions.whole_brain_emulation: Attempting computational simulation of relevant brain dynamics at a declared fidelity level.
conceptual_distinctions.identity_or_consciousness_transfer: Separate philosophical and scientific claim; neither connectome copying nor simulation alone establishes survival or transfer of personal identity.

elements.name: Open connectome dataset
elements.function: Provide documented neural connectivity and annotations; prefer non-human public research data for initial work.

elements.name: Biophysically inspired simulation
elements.function: Run simplified neuron and synapse dynamics; document assumptions and fidelity.

elements.name: JANUS neural adapter
elements.function: Convert simulated sensory features to spikes or states and map decoded outputs to bounded machine-readable action proposals.

elements.name: AI/transformer controller
elements.function: Provide language, memory, planning and tool-use proposals; do not conflate language fluency with neural authenticity.

elements.name: Demiurge / HRain cognitive graph
elements.function: Persist provenance, experimental states, editable semantic graphs and hypothesis-versus-measurement separation.

elements.name: Simulation environment
elements.function: Close a sensorimotor loop in a sandbox without live implant access or autonomous external actuation.

elements.name: Truth and safety gates
elements.function: Require replayable evidence, permission boundaries, privacy/consent checks and independent evaluation before any promotion.

data_flow: simulated environment -> encoded stimuli -> neural simulation
neural simulation -> decoder/adapter -> bounded action proposal
transformer and memory -> candidate interpretation or policy
safety gate -> simulated action -> environmental feedback
all input/state/decision metrics -> append-only experimental records

testable_hypotheses.question: Does a connectome-constrained neural adapter improve task learning or adaptation over an equal-budget non-connectome control?
testable_hypotheses.null: No reproducible improvement at the same data, parameter, compute and tuning budgets.

testable_hypotheses.question: Can the hybrid faithfully predict limited, independently measured neural or behavioral responses?
testable_hypotheses.null: No improvement over conventional learned recurrent and transformer baselines.

testable_hypotheses.question: Does a neural-derived latent interface add utility to JANUS memory, reasoning or control?
testable_hypotheses.null: No advantage over a conventional feature encoder feeding the same transformer.

preregistered_experiment_proposal.inputs: Publicly available fly connectome and non-identifying synthetic environment observations.
conditions: randomized connectivity matched for size and sparsity + transformer
safeguards: Freeze datasets, splits, seeds and decision thresholds before evaluation
Use independent held-out environments and negative controls
Keep failures, negative results and exceptions
Do not claim equivalent neuronal fidelity from task performance alone
Document license and attribution for datasets and code
preregistered_experiment_proposal.acceptance_gate: Only report an engineering benefit if it exceeds matched baselines on unseen tests with uncertainty estimates and fully replayable artifacts.

ethics_and_security.human_brain_data: No private clinical brain data, invasive devices or personal BCI recordings without legitimate authorization and explicit informed consent.
ethics_and_security.identity: No claim that the model is the original person or possesses copied memories/consciousness.
ethics_and_security.agency: Simulation outputs cannot automatically authorize real-world actions or modify safety gates.
ethics_and_security.research_priority: Start with open fly datasets and sandbox-only compute; use privacy-preserving protocols before any human-data work.

next_actions_proposed: Inventory compatible open connectome datasets, available code and licenses.
Specify a bounded adapter API for simulated spikes/states and observations/actions.
Implement a minimal reproducible simulation on GitHub Actions within compute quotas.
Compare against randomized-connectome and standard neural baselines on independent holdouts.
Store metrics, failures, seeds and experiment receipts as separate append-only JSON artifacts.
